name: El extraño Viaje de los Mensajeros
source:
Three couriers from different nations receive a mysterious package which they will have to send to the ruler of the land of eternity. The couriers will go their separate ways to fulfill their duty, however, their destiny is to meet and undertake this journey together where they will live adventures and somewhat strange situations that will test them on how capable they are to make good decisions.

[From [url=https://noreemii.itch.io/the-strange-journey-of-the-couriers]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
来自不同国家的三名信使收到了一件神秘包裹，必须将其送往永恒之国的统治者手中。三人起初各自踏上履行职责的道路，命运却注定让他们相遇，一同完成这段旅程。途中，他们将经历冒险与种种有些离奇的状况，考验自己能否作出明智的决定。

（摘自[url=https://noreemii.itch.io/the-strange-journey-of-the-couriers]itch.io[/url]）
